source_text: Domus in vico sine muro sicut ager — semper redimi potest. Humilitas aperta redemptori. Christus ager noster.
pass_a_gloss: House in village without wall like field — always to-be-redeemed can. Humility open to-redeemer. Christ field our.
pass_b_english: A [[house in an unwalled village is like a field — always redeemable >> Bible:Leviticus 25:31]]. Open humility to the Redeemer. Christ is our field.
